tei:div.tei:p: kyai rdor sgrub thabs/.................... (1) bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga....................... (55) kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du bya ba/..... (127) bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs bde chen rol mtsho/...... (134) bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i sgrub thabs snying po bde 'jug.... (194) dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po'i mchod 'phreng*/...... (236) bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs legs par bkod pa/..................... (260) dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lo dril gnyis kyi smon lam shis brjod/.. (280) zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ ..... (285) dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod chen dngos grub 'dod 'jo/... (300) dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi bstod pa/.............. (318) 'khor lo sdom chen gyi bstod pa/............... (319) dbang don mdor bsdus bstan pa gsal byed yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i 'phreng ba/................ (320) dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/.......... (340) dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mngon par rtogs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bzhed gzhung*/............
